observations: Photo 0 shows two retail boxes for Sonik AC/DC pressing irons.
The brand 'SONIK' is clearly visible on both boxes.
The model 'SPI-168DC2' is printed on the bottom box; the top box shows 'SPI-168D' with the rest obscured.
Box text claims 200-250W power, 5 temperature modes, and a 100% copper cable.
The actual irons are not visible; only the packaging is shown.
A '18 Months' warranty seal is printed on the box.

claims.claim: It's better care for your clothes

risks.risk: The iron may be missing, damaged, or a different model than the box indicates.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual iron out of the box, showing the model plate and soleplate.

risks.risk: The iron may not heat up or the thermostat may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the power indicator light turning on and the soleplate heating up.

risks.risk: The DC (battery/solar) functionality may not work.
risks.proof: A video of the iron being powered by and heating from a 12V/24V DC source.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual iron out of the box showing the soleplate.
Photo of the specification plate on the iron itself.
Video of the iron powered on and heating up.
Video demonstrating the iron working on a DC power source.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the packaging, allowing for a valuation at its worst-case condition (unseen/not working).
